episodes.description: Every year we see damage, death and destruction caused by hurricanes, cyclones and typhoons - tropical storms. Is climate change making this impact worse? episodes.title: How do we describe smells?
episodes.description: What is the worst smell in the world? And what is the best smell? Are there any smells that you like, but that your friends or family hate? Smells are all around us all the time, but the English language is often quite general in the way it describes smells, as opposed to other senses like sounds or tastes. But why is this? Neil and Georgie discuss this and teach you some new vocabulary. Get a free worksheet, quiz and transcript for this episode: https://www.bbc.co.uk/learningenglish/english/features/6-minute-english_2026/ep-260827 Practise...

episodes.descZh: 世界上最难闻的气味是什么？最好的气味是什么？有没有什么你喜欢但你的朋友或家人讨厌的气味？气味无时无刻不在我们身边，但英语对气味的描述通常相当笼统，而不是声音或味道等其他感官。但为什么是这样呢？尼尔和乔治讨论这个问题并教你一些新词汇。获取本期节目的免费工作表、测验和成绩单：https://www.bbc.co.uk/learningenglish/english/features/6-minute-english_2026/ep-260827练习.

episodes.title: Sharing the road with driverless cars
episodes.description: Imagine crossing a road and turning to see a car heading towards you... without a driver! While this might seem scary, driverless cars are already operating safely in many cities around the world. These autonomous cars contain huge amounts of technology to help them drive alongside other road users carefully. But will humans behave as carefully around them? Can we communicate clearly with these 'robotaxis', or are we simply incompatible? Phil and Pippa discuss this and teach you some new vocabulary. Learn English from authentic BBC programme clips.
